messages:
ryan: quick heads-up — docs scan flagged 3 images 404 and one page missing `owner:` frontmatter. link to scan: https://internal.docs/scan/1745 :eyes:
leila: which pages? can take the screenshot one (guides/setup/screenshot.md) today.
amanda: i can do the owner frontmatter add for audit-runbooks/infra-rotation.md, want me to just add `owner: @amanda` and a short note?
ryan: yep that works — scan output:
```
- guides/setup/screenshot.md -> 404 image /assets/screenshots/setup-step3.png
- api/limits/throughput.md -> 404 image /images/throughput-chart.svg
- tutorials/embedding-faststart.md -> 403 on cdn rehost
- audit-runbooks/infra-rotation.md -> missing frontmatter key: owner
```
devin: for the two 404s, rehostable copies live in s3://docs-assets/backup/2025-01. quick sed to rewrite paths: 
```
# run from repo root
git checkout -b fix/docs-image-rehost-1745
rg "(/assets/screenshots/|/images/)" -l | xargs sed -i "s|/assets/screenshots/|/cdn/docs/screenshots/|g; s|/images/|/cdn/docs/images/|g"
git add -A && git commit -m "docs: rehost broken image paths (scan 1745)"
```
devin: i'll push a PR tomorrow morning, pinging @amanda and @leila for quick review. :memo:
docs-bot: automated scan result uploaded: https://internal.docs/scan/1745/report.json (severity: medium)
leila: thanks — i grabbed screenshot.md and replaced the missing file with the s3 copy, pushed to branch fix/docs-screenshot-1745. linked PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4218
amanda: PR for frontmatter added: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4220 — added owner and a one-liner about scheduled review cadence.
ryan: awesome, leaving this thread for async followups. if CI flags anything else i'll bump. :thumbsup:
devin: will merge once CI green and amanda/leila approve. thx!
